# Dhruv Singh — Full-Stack Developer & Computer Engineering (Full Documentation)

## Overview

## Project Case Studies

### 1. Brainstormzz (AI Whiteboard Application)
- Status: Production Ready.
- Problem: Brainstorming sessions lack structured AI-driven visual expansion and intuitive spatial organization.
- Solution: Interactive whiteboard UI where single prompts generate multi-category structured idea cards with refinement tools and sub-1.2s response times.
- Tech Stack: React, HTML5 Canvas, Tailwind CSS, OpenAI API, Node.js.

### 2. Urban Carpool Matching System
- Status: Completed / Benchmark Validated.
- Problem: Daily urban commuters generate excessive single-occupancy vehicle traffic and high emissions.
- Solution: Python geospatial ride-sharing matching engine processing 500+ simulated rider coordinates and clustering pickups with 28% commute-time savings.
- Tech Stack: Python, NetworkX, Haversine Geospatial Algorithms.

### 3. Rover Arm Controller & CV Test Automation
- Status: Completed / Verified.
- Problem: Multi-axis robotic arms require rigorous physical repeatability and joint angle verification.
- Solution: Automated test framework using Python, OpenCV, and Arduino to automate precision verification across 6 servo joints with ARUCO tag visual feedback, achieving 99.2% tracking accuracy.
- Tech Stack: Python, OpenCV, Arduino, Hardware Serial, PySerial.

### 4. 8-Bit General-Purpose Processor
- Status: Completed / Verified.
- Problem: Understanding compute micro-architecture demands full-stack hardware design from logic gates to instruction execution.
- Solution: Custom 8-bit processor designed in VHDL with ALU, multi-state control FSM, general-purpose registers, and instruction decoders verified on Intel Quartus and ModelSim (100% waveform testbench validation).
- Tech Stack: VHDL, Intel Quartus Prime, ModelSim, Digital Logic Design.

### 5. Bookstore Application
- Status: Completed / Production Architecture.
- Problem: Retail desktop software often suffers from tightly-coupled business logic, making tier changes and inventory updates brittle.
- Solution: Desktop retail management system in Java Swing implementing the State Design Pattern for customer status tiers (Silver, Gold, Platinum) and Factory Pattern for item creation with file persistence.
- Tech Stack: Java, Java Swing, OOP Design Patterns.

### 6. Three-Stage MOSFET Voltage Amplifier
- Status: Completed / Verified.
- Problem: Micro-sensor signal conditioning demands high gain, wide bandwidth, and minimal thermal distortion in analog CMOS.
- Solution: 180nm CMOS multi-stage analog amplifier designed and simulated in KiCad and ngspice achieving 42 dB voltage gain and >1.8 MHz bandwidth.
- Tech Stack: KiCad, ngspice, CMOS Analog IC Design.
